'''Senna''' was a [[Gigoran]] [[Gender|male]] from the [[planet]] [[Gigor]] who was, along with others from his [[homeworld]], [[Slavery|enslaved]] by [[Zygerrian]] [[enslaver]]s whose actions were sanctioned by the [[Galactic Empire]]. Though he had not committed any crimes, his [[species]] was desired for its natural strength, and Senna was sent to the [[Pyke Syndicate]]'s [[Spice mines of Kessel|spice mines]] on the [[planet]] [[Kessel]].<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars NE" />

In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the events on [[Kessel]] in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' to nine years after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the formation of the Empire to [[19 BBY]]; therefore, the events on Kessel in ''Solo'' must take place in [[10 BBY]].</ref> he was carrying ore sampler hoppers<ref name="SoloOG" /> in the [[Mining|mines]] when a [[Raid on Kessel|slave revolt]] broke out in which the slaves were freed and overthrew the syndicate enforcers watching over them.

Senna had [[Color|white]] [[Hair|fur]]<ref name="Solo" /> that was permanently stained orange by Kessel's dust and wore a brown harness with a [[Vocabulator|vocoder]] that translated his [[Gigoran (language)|Gigoran speak]] into [[Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Senna first appeared in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="Solo" /> and was first named in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SoloOG" /> The name Senna was first used for an [[Unidentified large-armed species|alien]] character in [[John Knoll]]'s early drafts for the film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' and eventually developed into a Gigoran character that was reduced to a far more minor role in the film and renamed [[Moroff]].<ref name="Rogue One">''[[The Art of Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>
